name: pankajanupam/quick-events-manager
description: Create events, publish them, and take free registrations. Start simple and switch on more features only when you need them.

extra.note: PHPUnit is capped at 10.5 deliberately: PHPUnit 11 deprecates @dataProvider in favour of PHP 8 attributes, which cannot be used while the plugin still supports PHP 7.4. No composer.lock is committed, so each PHP version in CI resolves the PHPUnit release that supports it.

scripts.i18n: for po in languages/*.po; do msgfmt --check-format -o "${po%.po}.mo" "$po" || exit 1; done && echo 'Compiled all .po files.'
